query_rule: One source seed2 plural-minus-singular contrast from all full decoded contributions, balanced over template and attractor; no target task endpoints.

design.scope: One across-PP structural family, 16 lexicalized templates per split; not 32 independent syntactic structures. Programmatic synthetic grammatical labels, not human annotations. No claim of exclusion from base-model pretraining. Reserved prompts generated but not tokenized or forwarded this run.

primary: log P(correct is/are)-log P(incorrect is/are) in recipient context; interventions measured as baseline minus intervened margin
secondary: past was/were agreement margin and present-versus-past total probability log ratio; neither is independent human semantic evidence
intervention: Source native D_s diag(g_s)(z_s(recipient)-z_s(donor)), compared with projected direction and full SAE difference. Each natural operation independently capped0.1 without upscaling; not equal-dose or equal-search comparison.
budget_description: 64already developed inputs;8baseline+8noop+2unpadded+3methods*2axes*8batches=66forwards;<=180s numeric including<=60s source fit;loading<=90s expected.
selection: Source64task codes only;32unique subject pairs, single-atom vector-error reduction ranking, support64 signed ridge+clip[-1,1] .001. No target codes or endpoints;behavioral observations not fit targets. Actual native teacher measured against projected teacher and full SAE swap; all in-sample development.

padding_tolerances.scope: Separate unit-scaled float32 diagnostic after v1 max0.0003752576; fixed before v2 source interventions, not a scientific acceptance threshold.
